_note: Flywheel loop/route binding table (DESIGN.md §13 法定配置). Bindings live here, never in skills. All models run reasoning_effort/thinking=max (§7): pi via --thinking max; kimi CLI via per-invocation env KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT=max (never touches the user's global config).

judge._note: milestone final verification, fresh context (§7); K3 decided 2026-08-20 (§11.3 closed) — cross-vendor vs DeepSeek executors

hard._note: escalation route; K3 decided 2026-08-20 (§11.6 closed) — cross-vendor vs Flash; V4 Pro remains as channel fallback

opencode._note: OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go (same key, same pi built-in provider directory, verified 2026-08-20); terminal channel of the DeepSeek chain — no direct-API fallback needed (user decision 2026-08-20)

kimi-subscription._note: kimi code CLI subscription login (device-code OAuth), no API key injected

kimi-coding._note: pi built-in provider kimi-coding with k3 (1M context, verified 2026-08-20); fallback switches harness from kimi CLI to pi; hard route degrades to opencode V4 Pro (v0.13)

credentials._note: needs-live-credentials packets: human writes docs/<slug>/approvals/<packet-id>.json {"approved-env": ["KEY"]}; only listed keys are injected, per unit (§9)

intake._note: pluggable task sources (§4.5). github-issues needs the gh CLI; command sources cover CI failures / dependency upgrades / anything scriptable. Intake never freezes requirements — humans approve in triage-inbox.md, freezing goes through $flywheel-new.

sources.name: ci-failures
sources.cmd: echo '{"title": "example: nightly CI red on main", "summary": "test X failed twice", "url": null}'

defect-injection._note: always on (user decision 2026-08-20 — no switch): a sampled unit needs defect-injection.patch + test-cmd configured for the task, otherwise the orchestrator writes inbox asking a human to add them (unit still completes)

pricing._note: USD per 1M tokens, fallback when the driver reports no cost. pi reports usage.cost itself; DeepSeek direct uses peak/off-peak pricing (§7).
